tests.checks: s1 see: after Connect the phone flow waits for and asserts Health Connect's own allow screen; s2 see: the exact 'On. Each workout you finish ... (an estimate) ...' caption is asserted, so s2 not (row still Off) and the estimate wording are checked; s3 see: a 'Last sent: Today, hh:mm' line after a past send. The Stop button is never looked for
s3 not (data only): a demo send result says nothing was sent; the record sent is id, title, times and calories only
s3 not (data only): demo data leaves the owed list
s1 see (data only): the question says how many, from when to when and where they go, with a 'Send N workouts' confirm; s2 see (data only): 'Sending... 200 of 480'
s1 see: the 'Send N workouts to Health Connect?' question shows before the tap; s2 see: 'Sent N workouts to Health Connect.' after the yes
s2 not (data only): a part-way failure says 'Sent 750 of 1,500 ... Try again', never a plain success

s1 not, s3 see, s3 not (data only): by default only workouts since MettleUp's first run go, the words say why older ones are left out, the older-send question says they may show twice, and older ones go only with 'Send older workouts too'. 'Not now' and a second tap (s2 not) are not checked

s1 not (data only): deleting a workout removes it from Health Connect while sending is on, and after Stop when this phone sent before; s2 not (data only): only that workout's id is removed; a refused removal is logged (not that no error is shown on screen). The history screen (s1 see, s2 see) is not checked
s1 not (data only): Health Connect missing or old wins, so the row state is update/unavailable/none, never on
s3 see (data only): when Open Health Connect opens nothing the line points to the phone's Settings -> Health Connect. The 'Nothing opened?' and 'not available' words (s1 see, s2 see) are not checked
s1 see (data only): 'Sending...' progress words
s1 not (data only): 'Send again' sends nothing while sending is switched off

s2 not (data only): a workout finished while off is not sent or marked owed, and owed workouts are not retried while off; the Stopped words are checked only for being whole sentences, not their text. Turning on again (s3) is not checked
s1 see, s1 not (data only): the record sent for a workout is exactly id, title, start, end and calories (no sets, weights or notes); a demo send says nothing was sent
s2 see (data only): the words say older ForgeAI workouts are left out and only MettleUp ones go; the Stop promise (s2 not) is not checked

s1 not (data only): with the switch off nothing is read; s2 not (data only): the first read starts 30 days back and impossible weights (5 kg, 900 kg) are left out; s3 see (data only): the label is 'Weight from Health Connect'; s3 not (data only): two readings of one day make one entry and a typed weight is never changed. The about text, the On caption, the button and the 'Added 3 weigh-ins' line are only checked for being whole sentences

s1 see (data only): a new weigh-in lands in the body-weight log; s1 not (data only): the next read adds nothing (no duplicates). 'A line only when something was added' and 'a line every open' are not checked

s1 not (data only): a refused read returns 'not allowed' and a throw returns 'error', never a crash; s2 see, s2 not (data only): demo data reads nothing; s3 see (data only): the error words contain 'try again'. The exact refused words, the buttons, the row not claiming On, and whether a failed read starts the 10-minute wait are not checked

s1 not (data only): with the switch off nothing new is read; s2 and s3 (data only): a typed weight, and a Health Connect day the member fixed, are never overwritten. The Stopped words are checked only as whole sentences and no test checks that weigh-ins already added stay after Stop

s1 not (data only): with the switch off steps are not read; s2 not (data only): a refused read returns 'not allowed'; s3 see (data only): '6,240 steps so far today.'. The about words, the button, the row turning on with Stop, double counting and yesterday's steps are not checked

s1 not (data only): refused is 'not allowed', not a count; s2 not (data only): a throw becomes 'error', no crash; s3 see, s3 not (data only): 0 steps reads 'No steps recorded today yet.'. The refused and error words are checked only as whole sentences
s1 not (data only): off means no read; asking for steps asks only the steps read. The row going back to off and no second permission ask (s2) are not checked
s1 see: after allowing, the phone waits for the On caption, but the same wait also accepts the 'not letting MettleUp read your sleep' line, then asserts the switch is checked
s2 see: after a lighter workout with 5 h 10 min sleep the exact 'You slept 5 h 10 min last night...' line shows
s1 not (data only): switch off means Health Connect is never asked; s2 not (data only): no line after a heavier, same or first workout, nor in an easy week
s1 see: with sleep unknown the first protein tip shows and no sleep line; the same day no second tip; s1 not: with the sleep line no protein tip shows
s1 see (data only): at most one tip in 3 days, in turn; s1 not (data only): tip and sleep words never carry a number about food ('grams', 'you ate')
s2 see: switch off with 5 h 10 min made-up sleep: no sleep line after a lighter workout; after removing access the switch is off and no line shows

s1 not (data only): the made-up sleep is used only on a QA build with the switch on; s2 not (data only): switch off never asks Health Connect; refused or missing Health Connect gives 'unknown'. The exact refused words (s1 see) are checked only for style
s1 see: the same day a second lighter workout shows no tip
s1 not, s2 see, s2 not (data only): tips come in turn (0 then 1), wrap to the start only after the last, and at most once in 3 days
s1 not (server only): with the name on, the board shows 'Rahul S.' (first name and last initial), else 'A member'
s2 not (data only): the push carries the name switch and the pending mark clears only when the value sent is still the one chosen. The switch on screen (s1 see, s2 see) is not checked
s1 see (data only): 'Messages from my gym' is on by default and can be switched off
s1 not (data only): the member's gym-reminder switch off cancels them all
s1 not (data only): a push the phone must not show (switch off) is taken away and never rings
s3 not (server only): switching off deletes the trainer copy at once
s3 see: on a gym with trainer view the trainer switch and its caption show. The Busy machines switch (s2) is never checked
s2 not (data only): a name switch made with no signal keeps trying until it is sent
s2 see (server only): with the name switched off the board shows 'A member'. The switch on screen offline (s1) is not checked
s1 see, s1 not (server only): the stop call removes every shared workout of that member at once
s1 see (data only): switch off sends a stop, retried until it lands; s2 see (data only): switch on shares at once. Old shares coming back (s2 not) is not checked
s1 see (data only): the name switch is off by default and on joining a gym
s1 not (data only): a mate share carries no sets list and a body-weight-only workout shares 0 kg
s2 see, s2 not (server only): a member who hides the name shares but the profile never opens. Trainer and machines defaults are not checked
